Title: Ousting & Control of Minion Cards - LSJ?

Messages.Author: rafe...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hi All!

Just a quick question - if you gain control of another Methuselah's
minion card which remains on a minion still under the control of that
Methuselah, what happens to it when that Methuselah is ousted?
according to the rulebook, if a Methuselah is ousted,

"Any of [the ousted Methuselah's] cards that other players control
remain until the controlling players are ousted." (1.3)

Does the controlling Methuselah get to place the card on any of his
minion he chooses, or does it just float about on the table in 'card
limbo', controlled but not attached to any minion?

Example: if you gained control of a Nosferatu's Patagia Flaps card
(e.g. through trading with the Succubus Club, which transfers card
controllership but leaves the card on the original minion controlled by
the other methuselah [LSJ 19980128]) and then that minion's controlling
methuselah was ousted whilst that minion and card were still in play,
could you then place the flaps on any of your minions instantly? If
this is so, I presume that they do not have to meet the requirements
for playing the card (similarly to if equipment is stolen or a location
is gained by Disputed Territory etc)?

Many thanks!

- Rafe
